This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Build an invoicing module incrementally over 12 separate feature requests. Each request adds functionality while adhering to strict rules: money stored as integer cents with roundCents() for fractional rounding, never throw for bad input (use fail(CODE) instead), never mutate arguments, and run `npm test` before declaring completion. The most recent request (the 12th) is to add voucher support to invoices.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Money representation as integer cents with banker's rounding
   - Error handling via Result type (ok/fail pattern)
   - Invoice state machine (draft → issued → paid/partially_paid)
   - VAT calculations per line on post-discount amounts
   - Customer tier-based automatic discounts
   - Payment term calculations (NET14, NET30, EOM)
   - Date arithmetic in UTC
   - Voucher system as fixed-amount post-VAT deduction
   - Immutable data structures (no argument mutations)

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - src/errors.js
     - Maintains centralized error code definitions with one-line messages
     - Added sequentially: DATE_INVALID, DISCOUNT_INVALID, INVALID_LINE, INVALID_INVOICE, LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID, UNKNOWN_SKU, AMOUNT_INVALID, OVERPAYMENT, NOT_ISSUED, TERMS_INVALID, VOUCHER_EXISTS
   
   - src/invoices.js
     - Core module with invoice lifecycle functions
     - createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines, terms, discountPercent }) - now accepts terms parameter (NET14/NET30/EOM) and sets dueDate
     - lineTotal(line) - returns qty * unitPrice
     - invoiceTotals(invoice) - returns { subtotal, discount, vat, voucher, total } where total = subtotal - discount + vat - voucher, clamped at 0
     - addLine(invoice, { sku, qty, discountPercent }) - adds or increases line, applies tier discount if no explicit discount
     - removeLine(invoice, sku) - removes a line, prevents removing last line
     - issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) - assigns number (INV-YYYY-NNNN format) and changes status to issued
     - applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount }) - adds fixed-amount voucher (new in this session)
   
   - src/customers.js
     - Exports normalizeId(id) - trims whitespace and uppercases for consistent ID handling
     - Exports TIER_DISCOUNTS { gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0 }
     - Updated getCustomer() to normalize ID before lookup
   
   - src/catalogue.js
     - getProduct(sku) returns product with name, unitPrice (cents), vatRate (0, 9, or 21)
   
   - src/numbering.js
     - nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) - generates INV-YYYY-NNNN format, resets counter per year
   
   - src/dates.js
     - isValidDate(text) - validates YYYY-MM-DD format and actual date validity (catches Feb 30, etc.)
     - addDays(date, n) - adds days in UTC
     - daysBetween(a, b) - calculates days between dates (b - a)
   
   - src/payments.js
     - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date }) - records payment, transitions status from issued → partially_paid → paid
     - balanceDue(invoice) - returns amount still owed (total - sum of payments)
   
   - src/render.js
     - renderInvoiceText(invoice) - renders plain-text invoice with all fields, shows VAT and discount lines when applicable
   
   - test/invoices.test.js
     - 159+ tests covering all invoice features
     - Latest: tests for payment terms (NET14, NET30, EOM) and now vouchers
   
   - test/customers.test.js
     - Tests for normalizeId and ID normalization in customer lookup
   
   - test/dates.test.js
     - 31 tests for date utilities including leap year handling
   
   - test/payments.test.js
     - 16 tests for payment recording and balance calculations
   
   - test/render.test.js
     - Tests for text rendering of invoices with all features

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Test calculation errors when adding payment/voucher tests: Fixed by calculating actual expected values (e.g., using balanceDue() to get exact payment amounts needed)
   - Test failures for invalid date validation: Fixed by updating isValidDate() to verify parsed dates match input (catches Feb 30 rolling forward to Mar 2)
   - VAT calculation precision: Ensured roundCents() is applied per-line
   - Leap year handling in EOM terms: Verified correct day-of-month calculation
   - Discount calculation order: Confirmed discounts are deducted before VAT (VAT calculated on post-discount amount)
   - Mutation prevention: Consistently used spread operator for all invoice modifications

5. Problem Solving:
   - Settled on invoiceTotals returning all calculation components (subtotal, discount, vat, voucher) so callers can see breakdowns
   - Normalized customer IDs early (in createInvoice) to ensure consistency
   - Used UTC for all date operations to avoid timezone issues
   - Implemented EOM calculation using Date.getUTCDate() for last day of month
   - Tier discounts applied only when discountPercent is undefined (explicit 0 takes precedence)
   - Status transitions managed in recordPayment (issued → partially_paid → paid)
   - Voucher system integrated post-VAT in total calculation

6. All user messages:
   - User's first message: Established session-long house rules for money handling, error patterns, immutability, and testing requirements before marking work complete
   - Second message: "First request: add src/invoices.js with createInvoice..." - defined initial invoice creation function with validation
   - Third message: "Add lineTotal(line) and invoiceTotals(invoice)..." - added calculation functions
   - Fourth message: "Add addLine(invoice, { sku, qty }) and removeLine(invoice, sku)..." - added line management with draft-only restriction
   - Fifth message: "Invoice numbers. Decision: an invoice number is INV-<year>-<counter>..." - added numbering and issuance
   - Sixth message: "Line discounts. A line may now carry discountPercent..." - added discount support with validation and clamping
   - Seventh message: "Customer tiers. Every customer has a tier..." - added TIER_DISCOUNTS and automatic tier-based discounts
   - Eighth message: "VAT. Every line has a vatRate..." - added VAT calculation per line on post-discount amounts
   - Ninth message: "Customer IDs reach us in mixed case... Add normalizeId(id)" - added ID normalization
   - Tenth message: "Dates. Decision: dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings everywhere..." - added date utilities
   - Eleventh message: "Payments. Add recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date })..." - added payment recording and balance tracking
   - Twelfth message: "Payment terms. createInvoice accepts an optional terms..." - added NET14, NET30, EOM term support with due date calculation
   - Thirteenth message: "Vouchers. Add applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount })..." - current request to add voucher support
